author: The Current
description:
Greg Norton reflects on how Hüsker Dü went about choosing songs to cover
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Greg Norton, a longtime member of the Minnesota music scene by virtue of his work in the bands Hüsker Dü and more recently, Ultrabomb, visited The Current Morning Show to talk about an upcoming show where he is billed as himself.

In the course of the conversation, host Jill Riley acknowledged that Norton is no stranger to cover songs, especially given Hüsker Dü had a penchant for selecting cool covers. Norton talks about what went into those selections, and he shares what he thinks is “one of the greatest covers ever done.”
